Question Choices: Select. Which coordinate is written first in an ordered pair? ~~x | y~~
Solution: An ordered pair is (x,y): x gives horizontal position, followed by y for vertical position.

Question Choices: Fill: Write the coordinates of the origin. (__, __)
Hints: The origin is where both axes meet.
Solution: The axes meet at the origin. Horizontal and vertical displacement are both zero, giving (0,0).

Question Choices: Select. In which quadrant is the point $(-6, -2)$? ~~I | II | III | IV~~
Hints: Use both signs to choose one of the four quadrants.
Solution: The signs are x negative and y negative, placing the point in quadrant III. Quadrants I, II, III, IV have signs (+,+), (−,+), (−,−), (+,−), respectively.

Question Choices: Fill: Reflect the point $(-5, 4)$ over the y-axis. Write the new coordinates. (__, __)
Hints: Keep the coordinate along the mirror axis; negate the other.
Solution: Reflecting across the y-axis keeps y and reverses x. Thus (-5,4) becomes (5,4); the perpendicular distance to the mirror axis is unchanged.

Question Choices: Fill: Start at $(-3, 2)$ and move 8 units right, staying at the same height. Write the coordinates you land on. (__, __)
Hints: Update each coordinate by its signed movement.
Solution: x=-3+(8)=5; y=2+(0)=2. The final point is (5,2).
